turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so who decided, and on what basis?
Sorry, I'm a bit frazzled, it's report card week.
That's not Owen's problem, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
You're the first parent this month who's actually listened to me. Thank you. I mean it.
Save it, Hale. You've had two chances to tell me who decided, so tell me what you actually have.
I really needed that today. Can we just be kind to each other in here?
Kind would have been a phone call before the zero went in. I'm writing down that you still haven't answered me, and I have twenty minutes.
